method: Read-only source/diff and existing Why3 export review; no solver or model mutation
verdict: Source design and native driver interpretation accepted for isolated qualification; NOT qualified model or kernel acceptance
accepted_design: Fresh unrestricted int nan_seed allocated in each store_float invocation, passed explicitly to encode. No allocation at load or inside a cached codec definition.

MemLoader.stored routes C_float to store_float; stored_chunk forms Set(post_memory,write(pre_memory,encode(value,seed))). Existing final WPO closure uses F.p_close; Lang.p_close=e_close_forall. Source path supports universal rather than existential nondeterminism. Actual two-store C export remains required.

load_float deterministically reads UInt32/UInt64 bytes then decode; same unchanged memory is not reseeded. Source memcpy still invokes WBytes.f_memcpy on source/destination bytes without float decode/encode.

NaN encoding fraction is 1+(masked_seed mod (2^fraction_bits-1)); range is all nonzero fractions and no exponent carry. For desired sign s and payload p choose seed=(s<<(width-1))|(p-1). This gives every positive/negative quiet/signaling NaN representation for binary32 and binary64. This is a mathematical source argument, not a fresh solver claim.
Non-NaN encoding fp.to_ieee_bv preserves signed zero, infinities and subnormals; decoder uses SMT reinterpretation to_fp of int2bv, not numerical conversion. Native type check rejects Real.

Existing four Why3 exports (32/64, Z3/CVC5) contain native operators; roundtrip has universally quantified x and seed. They contain no codec inverse/range axioms or uninterpreted codec functions. These are synthetic explicit-seed probes, NOT end-to-end fresh-variable evidence.
required_before_qualification: Actual patched-WP SMT for two NaN stores must show distinct independent seed symbols, correct universal closure, no extra seed assumptions; include branches, loop obligations, function calls and aggregate copies to detect caching/scope effects.
Actual C controls: stable repeated observation of one store; NaN byte memcpy preserves all bits; two float stores must not force equal payload or a fixed payload/sign.

Actual canonical_nan body and memcpy validity/assigns obligations; finite/zero/infinity/subnormal decode and store/load at binary32/64; partial byte write and disjoint frame; separate endian-qualified configuration.

True/false and abstraction-negative controls including wrong bitcast, negative-zero bit equality, NaN self equality, bounds/alias/invalid memcpy. Timeout alone is not a semantic counterexample or proof of impossibility.
Final emitted SMT must contain native codec interpretation, no old CODEC_FLOAT axioms, no untranslated codec symbols. Restrict accepted provers to reviewed drivers.
Check inherited integer-byte memcpy changes separately and rerun all needed controls; unchanged function source does not establish whole-model correctness.

Run IEEE/FMA positive/negative regression and strict known-kernel smoke, then freeze independent source/install/share/drivers/solvers lock and replay. Old model and acceptance records remain unchanged.

NaN payload/sign are absent in decoded SMT FP values: audit consumers of signbit/classification on NaN. Output numerical equality-or-both-NaN does not qualify arbitrary C representation/flags observations.
